test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 26 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Win laurels
solution:
The correct answer is **'To gain honour'. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Win laurels **is an idiom that means** to obtain achievements or honors.**

 
 
• ***​Example* - ***Anand is a very hard-working boy, he is sure to **win laurels** in life.*
 
 
 
• So, **to gain honour **is the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.
 
• Hence, **option 1 **is the correct answer.
